To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the extracranian radiosurgery using one dose of 16 Gy is an effective and safe method of treating lung metastases of bone tumors, especially giant cell tumor of bone.
the patient with giant cell tumor of bone and lung dissemination was successfully treated by palliative radiotherapy and chemotherapy.

the patient with giant cell tumor of the bone and pulmonary dissemination, treated by chemotherapy, extracranial stereotactic radiosurgery and palliative lung radiotherapy, achieved a significant regression of metastatic lesions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of lung dissemination after surgical treatment of bone tumors, especially giant cell tumor of bone.
the problem of dissemination of giant cell tumors of bone to lungs and the possibility of treatment.
the problem of dissemination of giant cell bone tumor and its treatment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the giant cell tumor of bone is a rare, benign, primary tumor of bone, which can be locally aggressive and can metastasize to the lungs.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the treatment of lung metastases in case of GCT should be individualized and based on clinical and histological features of the primary lesion, the number of metastases, their size and the time from the primary tumor resection to the metastases appearance.
in the case of giant cell tumor dissemination to lungs a multimodality treatment should be applied, including surgery, chemotherapy, radiotherapy and radiosurgery.
in patients with giant cell bone tumor, a dissemination to lungs is possible.
The main takeaway from our work is that
in case of disseminated lung disease, palliative radiotherapy should be considered.
the treatment of disseminated giant cell tumor of bone should be individualized, taking into account the patient’s age, general condition, and the number, localization and size of metastases.
the treatment of metastases from GCT should be individualised and should include a combination of different therapeutic modalities.
